name: lysosomal trafficking regulator

function.text: LYST encodes lysosomal-trafficking regulator. It participates in pigmentation and leukocyte chemotaxis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Chediak-Higashi syndrome (autosomal recessive).
